source.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary for Schools Trainer · Exam Practice
source.selection: B1+–B2 useful vocabulary appearing on original Exam Practice pages; examples and explanations created for learning.

words.definition: causing little harm to the natural world
words.example: The company sells environmentally friendly clothing.
words.cloze: The company sells ________ clothing.

words.definition: harmful substances entering air, water or land
words.example: Natural cotton can be grown without creating pollution.
words.cloze: Natural cotton can be grown without creating ________.

words.definition: fair and not too expensive
words.example: The store offers sportswear at reasonable prices.
words.cloze: The store offers sportswear at ________ prices.

words.definition: made by hand rather than in a factory
words.example: We bought handmade sweets for our grandmother.
words.cloze: We bought ________ sweets for our grandmother.

words.definition: decorative items worn on the body
words.example: The shop sells beautiful jewellery and watches.
words.cloze: The shop sells beautiful ________ and watches.

words.definition: not often; on only a few occasions
words.example: You rarely find these ingredients in ordinary shops.
words.cloze: You ________ find these ingredients in ordinary shops.

words.definition: to suggest that something is good or suitable
words.example: I would recommend this shop for affordable suits.
words.cloze: I would ________ this shop for affordable suits.

words.definition: to make someone believe that something is true
words.example: The reviews did not convince him that he would see whales.
words.cloze: The reviews did not ________ him that he would see whales.

words.definition: expressing criticism or a bad opinion
words.example: He became worried after reading negative reviews.
words.cloze: He became worried after reading ________ reviews.

words.definition: next to and moving together with
words.example: A whale swam alongside our boat.
words.cloze: A whale swam ________ our boat.

words.definition: without being prevented by something
words.example: Despite its great size, the whale moved quickly.
words.cloze: ________ its great size, the whale moved quickly.

words.definition: a group of similar living things
words.example: Different whale species live near this coast.
words.cloze: Different whale ________ live near this coast.

words.definition: to move closer to something
words.example: Curious whales sometimes approach tourist boats.
words.cloze: Curious whales sometimes ________ tourist boats.

words.definition: wanting to find out more about something
words.example: The curious animal swam near the boat.
words.cloze: The ________ animal swam near the boat.

words.definition: physical or mental energy used to do something
words.example: The whale moved fast with very little effort.
words.cloze: The whale moved fast with very little ________.

words.definition: how well someone does a particular task
words.definitionVi: hiệu quả thực hiện; thành tích
words.example: Music may improve students' performance in school tasks.
words.cloze: Music may improve students' ________ in school tasks.

words.definition: as stated or reported by a person or source
words.example: According to the study, music can help learning.
words.cloze: ________ the study, music can help learning.

words.definition: a number representing part of a whole
words.example: Half is a fraction that students learn in maths.
words.cloze: Half is a ________ that students learn in maths.

words.definition: a regular pattern of sounds or movements
words.example: The children clapped to the rhythm of the music.
words.cloze: The children clapped to the ________ of the music.

words.definition: completely necessary
words.example: Careful listening is essential in an orchestra.
words.cloze: Careful listening is ________ in an orchestra.

words.definition: a large group of musicians playing instruments together
words.example: She plays the violin in the school orchestra.
words.cloze: She plays the violin in the school ________.

words.definition: very unusual and impressive
words.example: The apple has made an extraordinary journey through history.
words.cloze: The apple has made an ________ journey through history.

words.definition: to reach more places or people
words.example: Trade helped spread apple trees across different regions.
words.cloze: Trade helped ________ apple trees across different regions.

words.definition: including a wider range of different things
words.example: Farmers developed a broader range of apple varieties.
words.cloze: Farmers developed a ________ range of apple varieties.
